text:
Mari (Docs): FYI opened PR #6342 to switch dashboard presets -> structured console JSON. Main items: compact cost/latency pair widget, tracehook snippet consolidation, and broken link to /docs/kv-cache-prefetch. Need quick eyes.
Ethan (SRE): I'll run the staging smoke. Ping me once preview URL is live.
Mari (Docs): Minified widget sample:
```json
{"type":"latency_cost_pair","title":"P50/P95 latency vs cost","buckets_ms": [25,50,100,250],"cost_metric":"cost_per_1k_tokens","label_units":"ms"}
```
Ravi (SDK): Can you use cost_per_1k_tokens? That's what the telemetry exports. Also prefer explicit labels e.g. "<=25ms".
Grace (Product): Suggest we default to showing P95, with toggle for p50/p95. Also canary to 5% first.
Mari (Docs): Good, I'll update doc text and migration note. Added explicit bucket labels and p95 default.
ci-bot: link-checker: broken link found -> https://redwood.ai/docs/kvcache-prefetch (reported by crawler) :rotating_light: 
Mari (Docs): Replacing with /docs/kv-prefetching and adding netlify redirect; will push commit.
Ethan (SRE): Preview build: `make preview-docs ENV=staging` -> logs:
```
INFO render: 3 presets converted
WARN units: coerced seconds -> ms for legacy widgets
``` 
Ravi (SDK): Also updated tracehook snippets — consolidating examples across languages. Go snippet should accept and return context; PHP should use request attributes. Small Go example:
```go
func TraceHook(ctx context.Context, headers map[string]string) context.Context {
  if tid := headers["x-redwood-trace-id"]; tid != "" {
    return context.WithValue(ctx, "trace_id", tid)
  }
  return ctx
}
```
Mari (Docs): Added Ruby and Rust tiny snippets too. Ruby uses middleware insertion, Rust uses request.extensions().insert(trace_id).
Grace (Product): Ops wants a short note on on-prem caveats for trace headers (TLS proxies may strip headers). Add line.
Mari (Docs): Will add. CI reported one more link: /examples/old-tracehook -> 404, replacing with /examples/tracehook. Pushing final patch.
ci-bot: deploy-preview: PR #6342 build succeeded -> https://staging.redwood.ai/console/presets-preview :white_check_mark:
Ethan (SRE): Smoke looks clean. No telemetry anomalies in staging for 6h.
Grace (Product): OK to merge after canary gating config is set to 5% for 24h.
Mari (Docs): Done — gated rollout set. I'll follow up with changelog entry and screenshots. Thanks team :tada:
Ravi (SDK): LGTM
